name: wire_write_action
title: Wire: Run Write Action
description: Run a Wire WRITE action — one whose type is "write" (performs a state-changing interaction on the target site: submit a form, add to cart, post content). Submits POST /wire/task and, if the action is async, polls the job to completion. This operation changes state on an external site — review the action and params before running it in a workflow.
